purpose: Fresh audit-only prospective validation of the M9X payoff-decoupling architecture: reclaim-confirmed entry, N6 risk sizing, and selective runner profit management, without modifying or backfilling M9V.

base_candidate.source: Canonical M15 N3 only; do not import M5/H1/H4 M9V branch candidates into M9Y.
base_candidate.primary: M15 M7C-style post-start LONG PRIMARY: IDLE, RCI9 causal turn-up, EMA20>EMA30>EMA40.
base_candidate.native_exit: M15 M7C LONG_EXIT when latest fully closed M15 RCI9 >= 78.333333333333.
base_candidate.first_turn: First causal M1 LONG turn after eligible post-start PRIMARY and before native exit: previous M1 low <= minimum low of prior five-bar history, previous low < original PRIMARY bid/open, current closed M1 close > previous closed M1 close; first-turn decision/virtual entry time is next exact M1 open.
base_candidate.n3: At first-turn decision, latest fully closed M5 tick_volume_ratio20 <= trailing200 q50 OR latest fully closed M15 MACD(6,13) line in bps >= trailing200 q75.

w1_reclaim_entry.atr: Wilder ATR14 from latest fully closed M5 available at the canonical first-turn decision.
w1_reclaim_entry.immediate: If first-turn exact M1 open bid >= reclaim level, actual entry is that M1 open ask = open + spread*point.
w1_reclaim_entry.delayed: Otherwise observe at most 10 fully closed M1 bars. After the first M1 close >= reclaim level, enter at the exact next M1 open ask. Entry must occur before native M7C exit.
w1_reclaim_entry.timeout: If reclaim is not confirmed within 10 closed M1 bars or native exit occurs first, candidate is skipped.
w1_reclaim_entry.selection_note: 0.10 ATR / 10m is the central frozen reference cell; M9X showed a broad nearby plateau and this forward shadow does not adapt parameters.

risk_vector.n6_definition: At ACTUAL entry decision, latest fully closed H4 RCI9 empirical percentile within trailing100 fully closed H4 bars is >0.25 and <=0.50.

profit_vector.native_exit_event: Native M7C LONG_EXIT is a profit-management event, not automatically a 100% economic exit for runner arms.
profit_vector.runner_eligibility: At native exit decision, latest fully closed H1 MACD(6,13) line is strictly greater than the previous fully closed H1 MACD line.
profit_vector.runner_exit: First later M15 decision whose latest fully closed M15 RCI9 makes causal turn-down: current < previous AND previous >= previous2.

one_position_accounting.when_flat: Accept the next eligible W1 actual entry chronologically.
one_position_accounting.while_active: Do not open another trade in that same arm. Record later W1 entries as skipped/confirmation metadata.
one_position_accounting.runner_arms_active_until: Runner exit if runner eligible; otherwise native exit.

fresh_start_bootstrap.state_rehydration: Pre-start closed bars may be replayed only to determine M15 state. If M15 is ACTIVE from a pre-start PRIMARY, wait for native exit/return-to-IDLE before any new post-start PRIMARY can become M9Y eligible.
fresh_start_bootstrap.runtime_prefix: Use append-safe immutable-row-prefix semantics equivalent to M9V runtime v2; later strictly ascending appends are allowed, already-frozen rows may never change.

reporting.overlap_metadata: Record W1 candidates skipped because an arm still has an active runner/native position.
reporting.cost_reporting: Live/historical spread at entry where available; commission/swap remain separately labeled and are not claimed modeled.

review_gates.note: These are review checkpoints only. Y2/Y3 may resolve later than Y0/Y1 because runners remain open.
